title: Debugging and Profiling in C
summary: Diagnose before you change code: read evidence from corrupted memory, crashes, thread snapshots and measurements, then fix and defend the repair.
description: Every lesson hands you a deterministic failing program and evidence: guard bytes, a crash trace, a thread snapshot, work counters or a regression baseline. Learn to separate what the evidence proves from what it only suggests, make a focused repair and show that existing behavior still works. The six lessons finish with a mixed investigation. Supplied diagnostic output makes the course independent of an interactive debugger or hardware profiler inside the sandbox.
outcomes: Read a memory dump and locate the write that corrupted neighbouring data.
Separate what evidence proves from what it only suggests before editing code.
